headline: Catawba carry the lead into the final round
dek: Catawba beat Carson-Newman and Emory & Henry won at Wingate on Saturday, so the two points between them stand going into the last round of conference matches. Neither side has lost all season; on Wednesday Catawba are at home to Coker and Emory & Henry to Tusculum.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 21 and conceded four: the side chasing Catawba has got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Catawba have yet to lose and have conceded seven goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's win at Wingate on Saturday was their seventh of the season, against two draws and no defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's win at Lincoln Memorial on Saturday was their ninth of the season, against four draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coker's draw at Mars Hill on Saturday was their first of the season, beside six wins and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry's win at Tusculum on Saturday was their third of the season, against two draws and ten defeats.

last_match.line: Emory & Henry have yet to lose; Wingate have lost both conference matches since beating Tusculum.

next_match.line: Catawba have dropped points only in their home draw with Emory & Henry, and a win keeps them top whatever happens elsewhere.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
